title: Ask for a fresh instance
summary: Spring Framework: Ask for a fresh instance. Remove @Scope and compare.
introduction: Prototype scope makes a new bean each time the container is asked for it.
learningObjectives: Ask for a fresh instance with Spring Framework

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.

blocks.title: Ask for a fresh instance

blocks.text: Prototype scope calls the factory for each lookup. The two returned objects have different identities.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Spring does not manage full destruction of prototype instances for you.
